title.uz: SAT R&W: Boundaries — gap chegaralaridagi tinish belgilari
title.ru: SAT R&W: Boundaries — знаки на границах предложений

body.en:
A complete sentence has a subject and a verb and can stand alone: "The rain stopped." Where two complete sentences meet, there are three right ways to join them:
1. A full stop: The rain stopped. We went out.
2. A semicolon: The rain stopped; we went out.
3. A comma with and, but, or, so: The rain stopped, so we went out.
A comma alone is wrong (a comma splice): The rain stopped, we went out.
No mark at all is wrong too (a run-on).
However and therefore are not joining words: write "; however," between two complete sentences.
Test: cover the blank. If both sides can stand alone, choose one of the three joins.
body.uz:
Toʻliq gapda ega va kesim bor, u alohida gap boʻlib tura oladi: «The rain stopped.» Ikki toʻliq gap tutashgan joyda ularni bogʻlashning uchta toʻgʻri yoʻli bor:
1. Nuqta: The rain stopped. We went out.
2. Nuqtali vergul: The rain stopped; we went out.
3. Vergul va and, but, or, so: The rain stopped, so we went out.
Faqat vergul qoʻyish — xato (comma splice): The rain stopped, we went out.
Hech qanday belgi qoʻymaslik ham xato (run-on).
However va therefore bogʻlovchi emas: ikki toʻliq gap orasiga «; however,» yozing.
Sinov: boʻsh joyni yoping. Ikki tomon ham alohida gap boʻla olsa, uchta yoʻldan birini tanlang.
body.ru:
В полном предложении есть подлежащее и сказуемое, и оно может стоять само по себе: «The rain stopped.» Там, где встречаются два полных предложения, есть три верных способа их соединить:
1. Точка: The rain stopped. We went out.
2. Точка с запятой: The rain stopped; we went out.
3. Запятая с and, but, or, so: The rain stopped, so we went out.
Одна запятая — ошибка (comma splice): The rain stopped, we went out.
Без знака — тоже ошибка (run-on).
However и therefore — не союзы: между двумя полными предложениями пишите «; however,».
Проверка: закройте пропуск. Если обе части могут стоять отдельно, выберите один из трёх способов.

body.en:
Worked example: "Our class planted three ______ an apricot, a walnut, and a cherry."
Step 1: Is the part before the blank complete? "Our class planted three trees" — yes.
Step 2: What comes after? A list that names the three trees.
Step 3: A complete sentence followed by a list or an explanation takes a colon: "trees: an apricot…"
A semicolon would need a complete sentence after it, and a list is not one.
Now you: "The museum has one strict rule for ______ no photos with a flash."
Step 1: "The museum has one strict rule for visitors" is complete.
Step 2: What follows explains the rule.
Step 3: Which mark goes after "visitors"?
body.uz:
Namuna: «Our class planted three ______ an apricot, a walnut, and a cherry.»
1-qadam: boʻsh joydan oldingi qism toʻliqmi? «Our class planted three trees» — ha.
2-qadam: keyin nima keladi? Uch daraxtni sanab beradigan roʻyxat.
3-qadam: toʻliq gapdan keyin roʻyxat yoki izoh kelsa, ikki nuqta qoʻyiladi: «trees: an apricot…»
Nuqtali verguldan keyin toʻliq gap kerak, roʻyxat esa toʻliq gap emas.
Endi siz: «The museum has one strict rule for ______ no photos with a flash.»
1-qadam: «The museum has one strict rule for visitors» — toʻliq.
2-qadam: keyingi qism qoidani tushuntiradi.
3-qadam: «visitors» dan keyin qaysi belgi keladi?
body.ru:
Пример: «Our class planted three ______ an apricot, a walnut, and a cherry.»
Шаг 1: часть до пропуска — полное предложение? «Our class planted three trees» — да.
Шаг 2: что идёт после? Список, который называет три дерева.
Шаг 3: после полного предложения перед списком или пояснением ставится двоеточие: «trees: an apricot…»
После точки с запятой нужно полное предложение, а список им не является.
Теперь попробуйте сами: «The museum has one strict rule for ______ no photos with a flash.»
Шаг 1: «The museum has one strict rule for visitors» — полное предложение.
Шаг 2: дальше идёт пояснение правила.
Шаг 3: какой знак ставится после «visitors»?

body.en:
Watch out: never put a single mark between a subject and its verb.
"The students who finished the test early, went home." — wrong. "The students who finished the test early" is the subject; "went" is its verb.
A long subject makes you want to pause. Find the verb and ask "who went?" Everything that answers is one subject: no comma, no semicolon.
A who or that part that tells you which one (the students who finished early) takes no commas. Commas go around it only when it adds extra facts about someone already named: "My sister, who lives in Samarkand, called."
Such marks come in pairs: two commas or two dashes, never one of each.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: ega va kesim orasiga hech qanday belgi qoʻymang.
«The students who finished the test early, went home.» — xato. «The students who finished the test early» — ega, «went» — uning kesimi.
Ega uzun boʻlsa, oʻrtada toʻxtagingiz keladi. Kesimni toping va «kim ketdi?» deb soʻrang. Javob boʻlgan hamma soʻzlar bitta ega: vergul ham, nuqtali vergul ham qoʻyilmaydi.
Qaysi biri ekanini bildiradigan who yoki that qismi (the students who finished early) vergulsiz yoziladi. Vergul faqat nomi aytilgan odam haqida qoʻshimcha maʼlumot boʻlsa qoʻyiladi: «My sister, who lives in Samarkand, called.»
Bunday belgilar juft boʻladi: ikki vergul yoki ikki tire, hech qachon har xil emas.
body.ru:
Осторожно: никогда не ставьте один знак между подлежащим и сказуемым.
«The students who finished the test early, went home.» — ошибка. «The students who finished the test early» — подлежащее, «went» — его сказуемое.
Длинное подлежащее хочется разделить паузой. Найдите сказуемое и спросите «кто ушёл?». Всё, что отвечает на этот вопрос, — одно подлежащее: ни запятой, ни точки с запятой.
Часть с who или that, которая уточняет, о ком речь (the students who finished early), пишется без запятых. Запятые ставятся, только если она добавляет сведения о том, кто уже назван: «My sister, who lives in Samarkand, called.»
Такие знаки ставятся парой: две запятые или два тире, но не запятая с тире.

title.en: SAT R&W: Form, Structure and Sense
title.uz: SAT R&W: Form, Structure and Sense — shakl va moslik
title.ru: SAT R&W: Form, Structure and Sense — форма и согласование

body.en:
These questions ask: does the word fit the rest of the sentence? Check four things.
1. Agreement. The verb matches its true subject. One thing: is, was, has, takes. Several: are, were, have, take. Each, every and the number of count as one.
2. Pronouns. It and its for one thing, they and their for several. Its means "of it"; it's means "it is". Whose means "of whom"; who's means "who is".
3. Owners. One sister's bag, two sisters' bags, the children's coats.
4. Tense. Yesterday, last year: past. Next week: will. An action before another past action: had + verb (had finished). If they had known, they would have gone.
body.uz:
Bu savollar soʻraydi: soʻz gapning qolgan qismiga mos keladimi? Toʻrt narsani tekshiring.
1. Moslik. Kesim haqiqiy egaga mos keladi. Bitta narsa: is, was, has, takes. Bir nechta: are, were, have, take. Each, every va the number of — bitta deb hisoblanadi.
2. Olmoshlar. Bitta narsa uchun it va its, bir nechtasi uchun they va their. Its — «uning», it’s — «it is». Whose — «kimning», who’s — «who is».
3. Kimga tegishli. One sister’s bag (bitta opa-singilniki), two sisters’ bags (ikki opa-singilniki), the children’s coats (bolalarniki).
4. Zamon. Yesterday, last year — oʻtgan zamon. Next week — will. Boshqa oʻtgan ishdan oldingi ish: had + feʼl (had finished). If they had known, they would have gone.
body.ru:
Эти вопросы проверяют: подходит ли слово к остальному предложению? Проверьте четыре вещи.
1. Согласование. Глагол согласуется с истинным подлежащим. Один предмет: is, was, has, takes. Несколько: are, were, have, take. С each, every и the number of глагол стоит в единственном числе.
2. Местоимения. It и its — для одного предмета, they и their — для нескольких. Its — «его/её», it's — «it is». Whose — «чей», who's — «who is».
3. Принадлежность. One sister's bag (один владелец), two sisters' bags (два владельца), the children's coats.
4. Время. Yesterday, last year — прошедшее. Next week — will. Действие раньше другого прошлого действия: had + глагол (had finished). If they had known, they would have gone.

body.en:
Worked example: "The keys to the science room cupboard ______ on the teacher's desk."
Step 1: The verb goes in the blank.
Step 2: Skip the phrase that starts with "to": "to the science room cupboard".
Step 3: The true subject is "keys", several things, so the verb is "are", not "is". The nearest noun, "cupboard", is a trap.
Now you: "The basket of ripe peaches on the kitchen table ______ to my aunt."
Step 1: The verb goes in the blank.
Step 2: Skip "of ripe peaches" and "on the kitchen table".
Step 3: The true subject is "basket". Which verb matches it?
body.uz:
Namuna: «The keys to the science room cupboard ______ on the teacher’s desk.»
1-qadam: kesim boʻsh joyga keladi.
2-qadam: «to» bilan boshlangan birikmani tashlab oʻting: «to the science room cupboard».
3-qadam: haqiqiy ega — «keys», bir nechta narsa, shuning uchun kesim «are», «is» emas. Eng yaqin ot «cupboard» — tuzoq.
Endi siz: «The basket of ripe peaches on the kitchen table ______ to my aunt.»
1-qadam: kesim boʻsh joyga keladi.
2-qadam: «of ripe peaches» va «on the kitchen table» ni tashlab oʻting.
3-qadam: haqiqiy ega — «basket». Qaysi kesim unga mos?
body.ru:
Пример: «The keys to the science room cupboard ______ on the teacher's desk.»
Шаг 1: глагол стоит в пропуске.
Шаг 2: пропустите оборот с «to»: «to the science room cupboard».
Шаг 3: истинное подлежащее — «keys», несколько предметов, поэтому глагол «are», а не «is». Ближайшее существительное «cupboard» — ловушка.
Теперь попробуйте сами: «The basket of ripe peaches on the kitchen table ______ to my aunt.»
Шаг 1: глагол стоит в пропуске.
Шаг 2: пропустите «of ripe peaches» и «on the kitchen table».
Шаг 3: истинное подлежащее — «basket». Какой глагол с ним согласуется?

body.en:
Watch out: a describing phrase at the start of a sentence belongs to the noun right after the comma.
"Running for the bus, my bag fell open." — wrong: the bag was not running.
"Running for the bus, I felt my bag fall open." — right: I was running.
So ask: who or what does the action in the opening phrase? That noun must come right after the comma.
One more: the parts of a list keep one form: "to read, to write, and to draw", not "to read, to write, and drawing".
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: gap boshidagi tasvirlovchi ibora verguldan keyin darhol keladigan otga tegishli boʻladi.
«Running for the bus, my bag fell open.» — xato: sumka yugurmagan.
«Running for the bus, I felt my bag fall open.» — toʻgʻri: men yugurganman.
Demak, oʻzingizdan soʻrang: boshlangʻich iboradagi ishni kim yoki nima bajaryapti? Oʻsha ot verguldan keyin darhol kelishi kerak.
Yana bittasi: roʻyxat qismlari bir xil shaklda boʻladi: «to read, to write, and to draw», «to read, to write, and drawing» emas.
body.ru:
Осторожно: описательный оборот в начале предложения относится к существительному сразу после запятой.
«Running for the bus, my bag fell open.» — ошибка: сумка не бежала.
«Running for the bus, I felt my bag fall open.» — верно: бежал я.
Спросите: кто или что выполняет действие из начального оборота? Именно это слово должно стоять сразу после запятой.
Ещё одно: все части перечня должны иметь одну форму: «to read, to write, and to draw», а не «to read, to write, and drawing».

title.uz: SAT R&W: Mixed conventions — aralash meʼyorlar
title.ru: SAT R&W: Mixed conventions — смешанные нормы

body.en:
In the test, conventions questions are ordered by difficulty, not by rule. So name the rule first. Look at how the four options differ:
• Only the marks change (, ; : — .): Boundaries. Find where each complete sentence starts and ends.
• The word form changes (is/are, has/had, its/it's): Form. Find the true subject, the time, the owner.
• The word order changes: a modifier question. Who does the action of the opening phrase?
• A list changes shape: make every part match.
The subject can come after the verb: in "On the top shelf sit two old clocks", the subject is "two old clocks".
Naming the rule takes three seconds and stops you choosing by sound.
body.uz:
Testda meʼyor savollari qoida boʻyicha emas, qiyinlik boʻyicha joylashgan. Shuning uchun avval qoidani aniqlang. Toʻrt variant nimasi bilan farq qilishiga qarang:
• Faqat belgilar oʻzgaradi (, ; : — .) — Boundaries. Har bir toʻliq gap qayerda boshlanib, qayerda tugashini toping.
• Soʻz shakli oʻzgaradi (is/are, has/had, its/it’s) — Form. Haqiqiy egani, zamonni va narsa kimga tegishli ekanini toping.
• Soʻz tartibi oʻzgaradi — aniqlovchi savoli. Boshlangʻich iboradagi ishni kim bajaradi?
• Roʻyxat shakli oʻzgaradi — barcha qismlarni bir xil qiling.
Ega feʼldan keyin ham kelishi mumkin: «On the top shelf sit two old clocks» gapida ega — «two old clocks».
Qoidani aniqlash uch soniya oladi va «quloqqa yoqqani» boʻyicha tanlashdan saqlaydi.
body.ru:
В тесте вопросы на нормы идут по сложности, а не по правилу. Поэтому сначала определите правило. Посмотрите, чем различаются четыре варианта:
• Меняются только знаки (, ; : — .) — Boundaries. Найдите, где начинается и кончается каждое полное предложение.
• Меняется форма слова (is/are, has/had, its/it's) — Form. Найдите истинное подлежащее, время, владельца.
• Меняется порядок слов — вопрос о начальном обороте. Кто выполняет действие начального оборота?
• Меняется форма перечня — сделайте все части одинаковыми.
Подлежащее может стоять после глагола: в «On the top shelf sit two old clocks» подлежащее — «two old clocks».
Определить правило — дело трёх секунд, зато вы не будете выбирать «на слух».

body.en:
Worked example: "The coach, along with her two assistants, ______ already chosen the team for Friday's match."
Step 1: The options are has / have / having / to have: the verb form changes, so it is a Form question.
Step 2: Skip the extra part between the commas: "along with her two assistants".
Step 3: The true subject is "the coach", one person, so "has".
Now you: "The box of old letters, along with two faded photographs, ______ found in the attic last week."
Step 1: The verb form changes: a Form question.
Step 2: Skip "of old letters" and "along with two faded photographs".
Step 3: The subject is "box", and "last week" is past. Which verb fits?
body.uz:
Namuna: «The coach, along with her two assistants, ______ already chosen the team for Friday’s match.»
1-qadam: variantlar has / have / having / to have — feʼl shakli oʻzgaradi, demak bu Form savoli.
2-qadam: vergullar orasidagi qoʻshimcha qismni tashlab oʻting: «along with her two assistants».
3-qadam: haqiqiy ega — «the coach», bitta odam, shuning uchun «has».
Endi siz: «The box of old letters, along with two faded photographs, ______ found in the attic last week.»
1-qadam: feʼl shakli oʻzgaradi — Form savoli.
2-qadam: «of old letters» va «along with two faded photographs» ni tashlab oʻting.
3-qadam: ega — «box», «last week» — oʻtgan zamon. Qaysi feʼl mos?
body.ru:
Пример: «The coach, along with her two assistants, ______ already chosen the team for Friday's match.»
Шаг 1: варианты has / have / having / to have — меняется форма глагола, значит, это вопрос Form.
Шаг 2: пропустите дополнительную часть между запятыми: «along with her two assistants».
Шаг 3: истинное подлежащее — «the coach», один человек, поэтому «has».
Теперь попробуйте сами: «The box of old letters, along with two faded photographs, ______ found in the attic last week.»
Шаг 1: меняется форма глагола — вопрос Form.
Шаг 2: пропустите «of old letters» и «along with two faded photographs».
Шаг 3: подлежащее — «box», «last week» — прошлое. Какой глагол подходит?

body.en:
Watch out: the right option must fit the whole sentence, not only the words next to the blank. Read to the full stop.
• Pairs: if a comma or a dash opens extra information before the blank, the same mark must close it.
• Half sentences: a part that starts with although, because, when or if cannot stand alone. "Although the rain stopped, we stayed inside" is one sentence: a comma, never a semicolon or a full stop.
• One join is enough: "Because …, so …" uses two.
• Such as and including lead straight into their examples: no colon before or after them.
• Parts of a list that already hold commas are split by semicolons.
body.uz:
Ehtiyot boʻling: toʻgʻri variant faqat boʻsh joy yonidagi soʻzlarga emas, butun gapga mos kelishi kerak. Nuqtagacha oʻqing.
• Juftlar: boʻsh joydan oldin qoʻshimcha maʼlumotni vergul yoki tire ochgan boʻlsa, uni xuddi shu belgi yopishi kerak.
• Yarim gaplar: although, because, when yoki if bilan boshlangan qism alohida gap boʻla olmaydi. «Although the rain stopped, we stayed inside» — bitta gap: vergul qoʻyiladi, nuqtali vergul yoki nuqta emas.
• Bitta bogʻlovchi yetarli: «Because …, so …» da ular ikkita.
• Such as va including misollarga bevosita olib boradi: ulardan oldin ham, keyin ham ikki nuqta qoʻyilmaydi.
• Ichida vergul bor roʻyxat qismlari nuqtali vergul bilan ajratiladi.
body.ru:
Осторожно: верный вариант должен подходить ко всему предложению, а не только к словам рядом с пропуском. Читайте до точки.
• Пары: если перед пропуском запятая или тире открыли дополнительную информацию, закрыть её должен тот же знак.
• Половинки предложений: часть, которая начинается с although, because, when или if, не может стоять отдельно. «Although the rain stopped, we stayed inside» — одно предложение: запятая, а не точка с запятой или точка.
• Хватит одного союза: в «Because …, so …» их два.
• Such as и including сразу вводят примеры: ни до, ни после них двоеточие не ставится.
• Пункты списка, внутри которых уже есть запятые, разделяют точками с запятой.

body.en:
An Inferences question gives a short text that stops at a blank. You choose the ending that follows most logically, using only what the text says.
1. Find the pattern or the claim: what usually happens, or what someone believes.
2. Find the new fact, often after but, however or if.
3. Before you look at the options, say the ending in your own words: "so the change was probably caused by…".
4. Pick the option that matches your words.
The right ending is often careful: "most likely", "may", "cannot be explained by … alone". You never need outside knowledge to accept it.
body.uz:
Inferences savolida qisqa matn beriladi, u boʻsh joyda toʻxtaydi. Siz faqat matnda aytilganlarga tayanib, undan eng mantiqiy kelib chiqadigan davomni tanlaysiz.
1. Qonuniyat yoki daʼvoni toping: odatda nima boʻladi yoki kimdir nimaga ishonadi.
2. Yangi faktni toping, u koʻpincha but, however yoki if dan keyin keladi.
3. Variantlarga qarashdan oldin davomni oʻz soʻzlaringiz bilan ayting: «demak, oʻzgarishga ehtimol … sabab boʻlgan».
4. Oʻz soʻzlaringizga mos variantni tanlang.
Toʻgʻri davom koʻpincha ehtiyotkor boʻladi: «most likely», «may», «cannot be explained by … alone». Uni qabul qilish uchun tashqi bilim hech qachon kerak boʻlmaydi.
body.ru:
В вопросе Inferences дан короткий текст, который обрывается на пропуске. Вы выбираете окончание, которое логичнее всего следует из текста, опираясь только на то, что в нём сказано.
1. Найдите закономерность или утверждение: что обычно происходит или что кто-то считает.
2. Найдите новый факт — часто после but, however или if.
3. Прежде чем смотреть варианты, сформулируйте окончание своими словами: «значит, изменение, вероятно, вызвано…».
4. Выберите вариант, который совпадает с вашими словами.
Верное окончание часто осторожное: «most likely», «may», «cannot be explained by … alone». Для него никогда не нужны знания вне текста.

body.en:
Worked example: "A café sells more tea on cold days. Last week was very cold, but tea sales fell: the café's only kettle was broken. So the fall in sales ______"
Step 1: Pattern: cold days, more tea.
Step 2: New fact: the kettle was broken.
Step 3: In my words: the broken kettle, not the weather, most likely caused the fall.
Now you: "Yulduz's bus is usually on time, but on Monday it was twenty minutes late. That morning a water pipe burst on the main road, so all traffic had to use a narrow side street. The bus was most likely late ______"
Step 1: Pattern: the bus is on time.
Step 2: New fact: a burst pipe on the main road.
Step 3: In your words?
body.uz:
Namuna: «A café sells more tea on cold days. Last week was very cold, but tea sales fell: the café’s only kettle was broken. So the fall in sales ______»
1-qadam: qonuniyat — sovuq kunlarda choy koʻproq sotiladi.
2-qadam: yangi fakt — choynak buzilgan edi.
3-qadam: oʻz soʻzlarim bilan: savdo kamayishiga ob-havo emas, ehtimol buzilgan choynak sabab boʻlgan.
Endi siz: «Yulduz’s bus is usually on time, but on Monday it was twenty minutes late. That morning a water pipe burst on the main road, so all traffic had to use a narrow side street. The bus was most likely late ______»
1-qadam: qonuniyat — avtobus oʻz vaqtida keladi.
2-qadam: yangi fakt — katta yoʻlda quvur yorilgan.
3-qadam: oʻz soʻzlaringiz bilan?
body.ru:
Пример: «A café sells more tea on cold days. Last week was very cold, but tea sales fell: the café's only kettle was broken. So the fall in sales ______»
Шаг 1: закономерность — в холодные дни чая продают больше.
Шаг 2: новый факт — чайник был сломан.
Шаг 3: своими словами: продажи упали, вероятнее всего, из-за сломанного чайника, а не из-за погоды.
Теперь попробуйте сами: «Yulduz's bus is usually on time, but on Monday it was twenty minutes late. That morning a water pipe burst on the main road, so all traffic had to use a narrow side street. The bus was most likely late ______»
Шаг 1: закономерность — автобус обычно приходит вовремя.
Шаг 2: новый факт — на главной дороге прорвало трубу.
Шаг 3: как это сказать своими словами?

body.en:
Watch out for endings that go too far.
• Strong words: proves, always, never, all, only. Choose them only if the text is just as strong.
• Outside facts: an ending can be true in real life and still be wrong, because the text does not say it.
• Too many causes: if two or three things changed at the same time, the text cannot show that one of them alone caused the result.
• Only if: "a good harvest only if pruned" means every good harvest was pruned, not that every pruned tree gives a good harvest.
If two endings both seem possible, take the one that claims less.
body.uz:
Haddan oshib ketadigan davomlardan ehtiyot boʻling.
• Kuchli soʻzlar: proves, always, never, all, only. Ularni faqat matn ham shunchalik qatʼiy boʻlsa tanlang.
• Tashqi faktlar: davom hayotda toʻgʻri boʻlishi mumkin, lekin matnda aytilmagani uchun baribir xato.
• Bir nechta sabab: bir vaqtda ikki-uch narsa oʻzgargan boʻlsa, matn natijaga ulardan faqat bittasi sabab boʻlganini koʻrsata olmaydi.
• Only if: «a good harvest only if pruned» — har bir yaxshi hosil bergan daraxt butalgan degani, har bir butalgan daraxt yaxshi hosil beradi degani emas.
Ikki davom ham mumkindek tuyulsa, kamroq daʼvo qiladiganini tanlang.
body.ru:
Осторожно с окончаниями, которые заходят слишком далеко.
• Сильные слова: proves, always, never, all, only. Выбирайте их, только если текст так же категоричен.
• Внешние факты: окончание может быть правдой в жизни и всё равно оказаться неверным ответом, потому что в тексте этого нет.
• Слишком много причин: если одновременно изменились две-три вещи, текст не может показать, что результат вызвала только одна из них.
• Only if: «a good harvest only if pruned» значит, что каждое дерево с хорошим урожаем обрезали, а не что каждое обрезанное даст хороший урожай.
Если два окончания кажутся возможными, выберите то, что утверждает меньше.

stem.en:
Madina's bicycle had a flat ______ she walked to school on Monday.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: Two complete sentences meet at the blank. A comma with "so" joins them; a comma alone is a comma splice.
why.uz: Boʻsh joyda ikki toʻliq gap tutashadi. Ularni vergul va «so» bogʻlaydi; faqat vergul qoʻyilsa — comma splice xatosi.
why.ru: В пропуске встречаются два полных предложения. Их соединяет запятая с «so»; одна запятая — ошибка comma splice.

stem.en:
The museum has one strict rule for ______ no photos with a flash.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: "The museum has one strict rule for visitors" is complete, and what follows explains the rule, so a colon introduces it.
why.uz: «The museum has one strict rule for visitors» — toʻliq gap, keyingi qism qoidani tushuntiradi, shuning uchun ikki nuqta qoʻyiladi.
why.ru: «The museum has one strict rule for visitors» — полное предложение, дальше идёт пояснение правила, поэтому нужно двоеточие.

stem.en:
The small notebook that Laylo carries in her school ______ every new English word she learns.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: "The small notebook that Laylo carries in her school bag" is the subject and "holds" is its verb, so no mark goes between them.
why.uz: «The small notebook that Laylo carries in her school bag» — ega, «holds» — kesim, shuning uchun ular orasiga belgi qoʻyilmaydi.
why.ru: «The small notebook that Laylo carries in her school bag» — подлежащее, «holds» — сказуемое, поэтому между ними знак не ставится.

stem.en:
The old apple tree in our yard lost most of ______ leaves in the first cold week of October.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: The tree is one thing, so it takes "its" (of it). "It's" means "it is", and "their" is for several things.
why.uz: Daraxt — bitta narsa, shuning uchun «its» («uning») keladi. «It’s» — «it is» degani, «their» esa bir nechta narsa uchun.
why.ru: Дерево — один предмет, поэтому нужно «its» («его»). «It's» значит «it is», а «their» — для нескольких предметов.

stem.en:
The basket of ripe peaches on the kitchen table ______ to my aunt.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: Skip "of ripe peaches" and "on the kitchen table": the subject is "basket", one thing, so the verb is "belongs".
why.uz: «Of ripe peaches» va «on the kitchen table» ni tashlab oʻting: ega — «basket», bitta narsa, shuning uchun «belongs».
why.ru: Пропустите «of ripe peaches» и «on the kitchen table»: подлежащее — «basket», один предмет, поэтому «belongs».

stem.en:
Buried under thick snow after the storm, ______

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

options.en: the narrow mountain road stayed closed until noon.
drivers waited until noon for the mountain road to open.
the workers cleared the mountain road by noon.
there was no way to use the mountain road until noon.

why.en: The road is what was buried under snow, so "the narrow mountain road" must come right after the comma.
why.uz: Qor ostida qolgan narsa — yoʻl, shuning uchun verguldan keyin darhol «the narrow mountain road» kelishi kerak.
why.ru: Под снегом была дорога, поэтому сразу после запятой должно стоять «the narrow mountain road».

stem.en:
After practicing the piece for weeks, ______

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

options.en: Dilnoza played it at the school concert with no mistakes.
the piece was played by Dilnoza without a single mistake.
the concert went well because Dilnoza made no mistakes.
there were no mistakes when Dilnoza played the piece.

why.en: The opening phrase describes someone practicing, so the person, "Dilnoza", must come right after the comma, not the piece or the concert.
why.uz: Boshlangʻich ibora mashq qilgan odamni tasvirlaydi, shuning uchun verguldan keyin darhol «Dilnoza» kelishi kerak, asar yoki konsert emas.
why.ru: Начальный оборот описывает того, кто репетировал, поэтому сразу после запятой должно стоять «Dilnoza», а не пьеса или концерт.

stem.en:
The box of old letters, along with two faded photographs, ______ found in the attic last week.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: Skip "of old letters" and the part between the commas: the subject "box" is one thing, and "last week" is past, so "was".
why.uz: «Of old letters» va vergullar orasidagi qismni tashlab oʻting: ega «box» — bitta, «last week» — oʻtgan zamon, shuning uchun «was».
why.ru: Пропустите «of old letters» и часть между запятыми: подлежащее «box» — один предмет, «last week» — прошлое, поэтому «was».

stem.en:
Because the bridge on the river road was closed for ______ school bus took a longer route through the old part of town.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

why.en: "Because the bridge … repairs" cannot stand alone, so it joins the main sentence with a comma; adding "so" makes two linking words.
why.uz: «Because the bridge … repairs» alohida gap boʻla olmaydi, shuning uchun asosiy gapga vergul bilan qoʻshiladi; «so» qoʻshilsa, ikkita bogʻlovchi boʻladi.
why.ru: «Because the bridge … repairs» не может стоять отдельно, поэтому присоединяется к главной части запятой; с «so» получится два союза.

stem.en:
Every spring, the swallows that nest under the roof of Nilufar's school return in the second week of April. This year the school's roof was repaired in March, and the workers removed all the old mud nests. The swallows came back on time but flew around the building for a few days and then left. The birds most likely ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.en: left because their old nests were no longer there.
returned late because the spring was colder than usual.
never use the same building two years in a row.
were frightened away by the students in the school yard.

why.en: The swallows came back on time, found that the old nests had been removed, and left, so the missing nests most likely made them leave.
why.uz: Qaldirgʻochlar oʻz vaqtida qaytdi, eski uyalar buzib tashlanganini koʻrdi va ketdi, demak ularni ketishga ehtimol uyalar yoʻqligi majbur qilgan.
why.ru: Ласточки вернулись вовремя, увидели, что старых гнёзд нет, и улетели, значит, вероятнее всего, их прогнало отсутствие гнёзд.

instructions.en: Read the text. Choose the ending that follows most logically from it.
instructions.uz: Matnni oʻqing. Undan mantiqan eng toʻgʻri kelib chiqadigan davomni tanlang.
instructions.ru: Прочитайте текст. Выберите окончание, которое логичнее всего из него следует.

stem.en:
Yulduz's bus is usually on time, but on Monday it was twenty minutes late. That morning a water pipe burst on the main road, so all traffic had to use a narrow side street. The bus was most likely late ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.en: because of the burst pipe on its usual road.
because the driver was new to the route.
because fewer people took the bus on Monday.
because buses are often late on Mondays.

why.en: The new fact is the burst pipe that sent all traffic onto a side street, so it most likely made the usually punctual bus late.
why.uz: Yangi fakt — barcha transportni tor koʻchaga yuborgan yorilgan quvur, demak odatda oʻz vaqtida keladigan avtobus ehtimol shu sababli kechikkan.
why.ru: Новый факт — прорвало трубу, и весь транспорт пустили по узкой боковой улице; вероятно, поэтому обычно пунктуальный автобус и опоздал.

stem.en:
In September, the school canteen started serving soup at lunch, moved the fruit bowl next to the cash desk, and made every portion of chips smaller. By December, the canteen was selling twice as much fruit as it had a year earlier. The head cook believes the soup was the reason. Based on the text, however, the rise in fruit sales ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?

options.en: may have come from any one of the changes, or from several.
proves that students prefer soup to every other lunch dish.
was caused only by the smaller portions of chips.
shows that students always choose the food closest to them.

why.en: Three changes came at once, so the text cannot say which one raised fruit sales; "proves", "only" and "always" claim far more than it shows.
why.uz: Uchta oʻzgarish bir vaqtda boʻlgan, shuning uchun matn meva savdosini qaysi biri oshirganini ayta olmaydi; «proves», «only», «always» juda koʻp daʼvo qiladi.
why.ru: Три изменения произошли одновременно, поэтому по тексту нельзя сказать, какое из них подняло продажи фруктов; «proves», «only», «always» утверждают слишком много.
